notes.title: Major Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hopefully final update regarding cards covering objects.

I have gone through every level and zoomed out to fix everything in screen, this means objects are much smaller now in levels. 

If this becomes an issue I can always work on it one last time.

notes.title: Another Small Fix Sorry
notes.notes:
2nd Update today, apologies. Just wanted to fix everything asap for new players.

[b]- Fixed resizable windows to stop the glitching each level.[/b]
[b]- Smaller move cards to avoid covering puzzle pieces[/b]
